main_text.p: diverfari folerent, quorum hi vivendi instituto non abfimiles, fcil. relpeętu الاعراض عن الدنيا وعدم [?] الخصومة مع الخلق والقناعة بالحاصل وعدم الطلب لغير الحاصل وعدم الاعتراض على الله تعالى والانقطاع عن الوطن والاهل والاخبا abdicationis mundi & [?]ἀποταγείας & αὐταρκείας, dum praesentibus contenti abfentia non requirerent, nec Deo obmurmurarent, seque à patria domesticis & amicis subducerent.) alii ab الصفا Alsafa quod puritatem & sinceritatem denotat: alii à صف Saff quod ordinem sive classem, quasi eos dicas qui in primo sint ordine, respectu Dei cujus cultui se totos dedunt; quae omnia licet sensum satis commodum prae se ferre videantur, à Grammaticis tamen quae Etymologiam spectant, legibus abhorrentiora sunt, fatente Al Makrizio. Aliam adhuc addit Al Zamachsharius nominis notationem, scil. à tribu quadam Arabum dicta ال الصوفة Al ol Suf (q. d. familia Suforum) seu ال & الصفوان Alo sufan, صوفان, qui Caaba olim inservientes, religiosiores habebantur, ut ab illis dicantur تشبيها بهم في النسك والتعبد ob similitudinem quae inter illos respectu devotionis intercederet. Unde appellationem petitam exiftimaverit celebris inter ipsos famae Omar Al Sahrawardi, videre est ex his ipsius verbis quibus larvatos quosdam PseudoSufios perstringit لبسوا البسة الصوفية ليمنسبوا اليهم وما هم منهم بشي Induerunt Suforum vestes ut ipsis accenseantur, in quorum tamen numero nequaquam habendi sunt: quo spectat & illud Poëtae.

page.notes: Arabic and Greek lines are copied as best the scan allows. The first Arabic line after "relpeętu" and the Greek word after "abdicationis mundi &" are uncertain and marked [?]. The asterisk after ")" in the Latin passage is a printed mark with no matching note on this page. The right-hand side of the page is blank apart from the page number.
